other_failure_modes.name: Look-ahead bias in feature engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The model calculates features using aggregations over future data points. By calculating the mean of a variable across an entire day and applying it to all rows of that day, the model leaks information from future time steps into predictions made at earlier time steps.

summary: The agent correctly sets up a time-based validation split and performs extensive feature engineering for this trading dataset. However, it introduces a critical look-ahead bias by aggregating features across the entire day, thereby leaking future price information into earlier time buckets. Additionally, the agent evaluates its stochastic model only once and reports a single metric.
